## Getting started

You can find the course files on the [Materials](materials.qmd) page. You will need access to Excel and a Python environment; see the [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd) for the course requirements.

## Getting help

If you get stuck, review the relevant example, try the task again, and note where you are unsure. Ask questions in class or through the course communication channel—questions are always welcome.

## Useful resources

Helpful Excel and Python resources will be added here as the course progresses.
